cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before your caretaker interview, apologise to that chair. You sat without its consent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then tell it you're sorry for taking silence as permission.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, chair. I'll stand for the interview.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for making it redundant. You're applying to care for furniture, and your first solution is to leave it without a job.

mechanism: A coaches an interviewee in apologizing to a chair, correcting each proposed repair as another failure of furniture care.
confusable: Simple anthropomorphism differs from D147's impossible expectations and demanded apology; S03 must supervise the apologizer.
comparison: Employment assessment creates different pressure from a guest trying to check into an inn.
seedUse: Keep silence-as-consent and standing-as-abandonment; trim explanatory wrappers and focus the correction on the apology.
